content.text: MongoDB supports GeoJSON and legacy coordinate pairs for location queries. Use 2dsphere indexes for spherical geometry.

questions.question: What index type is required for $near queries?
questions.explanation: $near requires a 2dsphere index for spherical (real-world) coordinates.

faq.q: What coordinate order does GeoJSON use?
faq.a: GeoJSON uses [longitude, latitude] order — the opposite of what many people expect.
